6:11 AM

Three good picks under ₹50,000 all with 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD:

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM
MSI Modern 14 C7M	around ₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16GB
Acer Aspire 14 AI	around ₹43,999	Snapdragon X	16GB
Lenovo ThinkBook 16 Gen 7	around ₹46,990	Ryzen 5 7535HS	16GB DDR5
MSI Modern 14: cheapest of the three and light at about 1.4kg, but stock can be patchy and the battery is smaller.
Acer Aspire 14 AI: about 15 hours of battery and a 120Hz screen, but some Windows apps may not run on its Arm chip.
ThinkBook 16: the fastest chip and upgradeable RAM and SSD, but heavier at about 1.7kg with a dim screen.

These prices and specs come from one review site that has not tested the laptops itself, so check the shop price before buying. If you want a bigger screen, the Dell Inspiron 15 3535 (around ₹43,999) is the next best option.
